venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.weather: Sunny with highs in the mid 70s and lows in the 40s.
venues.notes_summary: One of the milder Fridays we have seen at Close Company ATL since our opening day. Given the weather, I thought we would have seen more foot traffic come our way to start off the weekend.

venues.name: D&C DC
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Saturday 3/14.** Garden steady with large parties; Jada alone most of the night until Khaleel helped; Garden closed at 11 and Jada swapped inside. D&C: steady night with a solid book; late reservations left some dead tables; short waits; many birthdays including Josh's (balloons behind the bar); room nearly cleared by 1am, natural last call, all out by 1:30. Kitchen: just shy of 12% of sales, selling food up to last call; Garden scoop and serve bar snacks need to be sent to the kitchen. MOD: Josh / Jamal / Cory.

venues.name: D&C EV
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Saturday 3/14.** Looney Tunes first hour as the St. Patrick's weekend crowd lined the block; mix of feral nightcappers and guests avoiding revelers; made new regulars from an engagement night. Comps $283.94. Top sellers: First Time Listener, Material Control, Buckhorn Exchange. Door: doozy of a Saturday with the new system; toggling and frustration with buttons, still ironing out tracking reservations and waitlist times, but kept a full room and the waitlist mostly worked; busy St. Paddy's foot traffic, not the demographic; industry and friends of staff. No-shows: Gordon Tsai 2 @ 8pm; Phillip Theodore Pribadi 2 @ 8pm; Holly Shimabukuro 2 @ 10pm; James Kwan 2 @ 11:45. Kitchen: good job.
